summary: A reply paused a person's line in a campaign: the person, enrolled until then, is paused, so none of their touches there is taken until the line is continued or ended; the line names the person and the reply line that paused them.

contact_ids.description: The people paused, each enrolled in the campaign until the reply.

line.description: The campaign's inbound_reply_observed line that paused them, by its id.
